final_message: Fixed nested range formatting: inner formatters weren’t receiving default debug specs, and temporary elements couldn’t bind to mutable references. The fix parses underlying formatters and binds each element as an lvalue, restoring quoted character output and allowing split/transform ranges to compile. Added regression coverage and updated documentation.
